defs.def: a medical condition in which a person has a temperature that is higher than normal 发烧；发热

ex.s: Symptoms usually start two days to three weeks following infection, and include fever, sore throat, muscular pain and headaches.
ex.t: 症状通常在感染后两天到三周开始出现，包括发热、咽喉痛、肌肉疼痛和头痛。

ex.s: One medical text from the fourth century suggested using the extract from sweet wormwood to treat a fever.
ex.t: 第四世纪的一本医学文献建议用青蒿提取物来治疗发热。

ex.s: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by!
ex.t: 我太沉浸在派对的热烈气氛中，几乎没注意到五个小时飞逝而过！

ex.s: BCE 6 Alexander came down with a fever and died.
ex.t: 公元前6年，亚历山大发烧后死亡。

defs.def: a particular type of disease in which sb has a high temperature 主要用于构成复合词

ex.s: People suffer from high fever, serious vomiting and terrible headaches when they have the disease.
ex.t: 患者得病时会发高烧、严重呕吐和剧烈头痛。

defs.def: a state of nervous excitement 激动不安；兴奋紧张
great interest or excitement about sth 尤用于构成复合词

chunks.cn: 高的发烧 / 派对发烧
对待发烧 / 包含发烧
